guard: manager boot gives post-heal re-registration fresh scoped authority and resumes the same registration operation, re-sending its credential family as one eviction request
why: The suite imports Manager relatively, so manager.ts mutations are live. Core is rebuilt by the
command because registerServiceInstance and the repair cursor live in @cotal-ai/core.
MUTATION 1 restores the defect: heal and the following registration share one executor window,
so a six-second credential expires during the new registration's delayed family eviction.
MUTATION 2 sends the registration's family one holder per eviction request, so each attempt
costs eight requests instead of one.

mutations.name: remove the fresh-authority boundary after boot heal
mutations.expectRed: compressed-lifetime takeover converges under fresh authority
mutations.cell: compressed-lifetime takeover converges under fresh authority
mutations.note: Without a new executor after the eight-holder boot heal, the six-second registration window is already exhausted and the takeover cannot converge.

mutations.name: registration evicts its family one holder per request
mutations.replace:
const gone: boolean[] = [];
      for (const h of pending) gone.push(...(await args.barrier.evict([h])));
mutations.expectRed: registration resume re-sends the family as one request
mutations.cell: registration resume re-sends the family as one request
mutations.note: The gate still reopens with one request per holder. Only the request count changes, which this cell counts.
